description: WEB06 kitchen asset catalogue (D8). Files live in ./files. VIS02 equipment and VIS03 assembly-line models are made by the team with npm run kitchen:models. VIS02 equipment uses layout material overrides; VIS03 line models embed existing colour and normal maps. Legacy models remain available. Models: glTF / GLB, metres, Y-up, origin at the bottom centre, belt travel along +X.
